about: What a place gives the player (docs/research/new-world-place-gives.md). A place record's gives list points here by id.

kinds.name: Boat stop
kinds.delivers: A boatman or raft-master of the place whose dialogue takes the player on each boat route of the place's stop (newworld/sources/travel/network.json) for that route's fixed fare, landing at the destination's arrival point.
kinds.evidence: Skyrim's carriage drivers and the Northern Maiden's captain: a topic per destination, the fare gated on the player's gold, Game.FastTravel to a marker (DialogueCarriageSystem; the ToSolstheim and ToSkyrim markers). Morrowind's shipmasters ran a port-to-port ring along the coast.

kinds.name: Coach stop
kinds.delivers: A carter of the place whose dialogue takes the player on each coach route of the place's stop for its fixed fare, by a major road the whole way.
kinds.evidence: Skyrim's five stable carriages (the hold cities' Stable markers), with the driver's topics and fares (CarriageCost 20, CarriageCostSmall 50); Morrowind's silt striders charged by distance.

kinds.name: Rootworm stop
kinds.delivers: A root-tender at the place's Hist who calls the rootworm and sends the player on each rootworm route of the place's stop for the flat fare.
kinds.evidence: Skyrim's carriage dialogue for the delivery; Morrowind's Mages Guild guides and propylons for a fixed link between a few named sites.

kinds.name: General goods trader
kinds.delivers: Buys everything not on the VendorNoSale list and sells mixed stock; 750 gold to start, restocked every 48 hours.
kinds.evidence: Vendor factions buying all but Key,VendorNoSale: 29 (caravans, Belethor, Riverwood Trader, Pawned Prawn); the commonest vendor.

kinds.name: Blacksmith trader
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells weapons, armour, arrows, ingots, ore, hides and tools.
kinds.evidence: 24 vendor factions with the list AnimalHide,Armor,Arrow,OreIngot,Tool,Weapon (every hold city's smith, the quartermasters, the Orc strongholds).

kinds.name: Apothecary
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells ingredients, potions, poisons, food and recipes.
kinds.evidence: 22 vendor factions with AnimalPart,Food,FoodRaw,Ingredient,Poison,Potion,Recipe (Arcadia's Cauldron, the White Phial).

kinds.name: Spell vendor
kinds.delivers: Sells spell tomes (name the schools and the highest tier sold), scrolls, staves, soul gems, robes, jewellery and books.
kinds.evidence: 17 vendor factions with Book,Clothing,DaedricArtifact,Jewelry,Scroll,SoulGem,SpellTome,Staff (court wizards, the College); 111 spell tomes: Conjuration 29, Destruction 27, Restoration 22, Alteration 17, Illusion 16, Novice to Master.

kinds.name: Innkeeper or food seller
kinds.delivers: Sells food and drink, buys food; an innkeeper also rents a room (see inn-room).
kinds.evidence: 29 vendor factions buying Food,FoodRaw (the inns, the market stalls); 20 LocTypeInn locations.

kinds.name: Fletcher
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells bows, arrows and light weapons.
kinds.evidence: 2 vendor factions with Armor,Arrow,Tool,Weapon (Fletcher in Solitude).

kinds.name: Jeweller
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells gems, jewellery, ingots and tools.
kinds.evidence: 3 vendor factions with Gem,Jewelry,OreIngot,Tool (Markarth's jewellery stall).

kinds.name: Clothier
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells clothing and jewellery.
kinds.evidence: 1 vendor faction with Clothing,Jewelry (Radiant Raiment).

kinds.name: Bookseller
kinds.delivers: Buys and sells books and spell tomes.
kinds.evidence: 1 vendor faction with Book,SpellTome (Urag gro-Shub).

kinds.name: Hunter buyer
kinds.delivers: Buys hides, animal parts and raw meat out in the wild.
kinds.evidence: WEServicesHunterFaction buys AnimalHide,AnimalPart,FoodRaw: 24 hunters met on the road.

kinds.name: Fence
kinds.delivers: Buys stolen goods (OnlyBuysStolenItems or the fence perk's list).
kinds.evidence: 1 vendor faction flagged stolen-only (Tonilia); the other fences open through the Thieves Guild.

kinds.name: Forge
kinds.delivers: Makes weapons and armour from ingots, leather and strips.
kinds.evidence: 100 placed with keyword CraftingSmithingForge in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Anvil
kinds.delivers: Bethesda pairs one with every forge; record it with the forge, not alone.
kinds.evidence: 100 placed with keyword (the forge's own anvil, CraftingSmithingForge) in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Workbench
kinds.delivers: Improves armour (smithing tempering).
kinds.evidence: 91 placed with keyword CraftingSmithingArmorTable in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Grindstone
kinds.delivers: Improves weapons.
kinds.evidence: 120 placed with keyword CraftingSmithingSharpeningWheel in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Smelter
kinds.delivers: Turns ore into ingots.
kinds.evidence: 41 placed with keyword CraftingSmelter in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Tanning rack
kinds.delivers: Turns hides into leather and strips.
kinds.evidence: 133 placed with keyword CraftingTanningRack in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Arcane enchanter
kinds.delivers: Learns enchantments by disenchanting and enchants items with filled soul gems.
kinds.evidence: 101 placed with keyword WICraftingEnchanting / isEnchanting in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Alchemy lab
kinds.delivers: Makes potions and poisons from ingredients.
kinds.evidence: 167 placed with keyword WICraftingAlchemy / isAlchemy in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Cooking pot
kinds.delivers: Cooks food that restores health and stamina.
kinds.evidence: 260 placed with keyword CraftingCookpot (197 small pots, 63 spits) in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Oven
kinds.delivers: Bakes pies and bread (HearthFires).
kinds.evidence: 3 placed with keyword BYOHCraftingOven in Skyrim+DLC.

kinds.name: Staff enchanter
kinds.delivers: Makes staves from a staff, a heart stone and a soul gem (Dragonborn).
kinds.evidence: 1 placed in Skyrim+DLC (DLC2StaffEnchanter keyword, in Dragonborn), the rarest crafting station.

kinds.name: Atronach forge
kinds.delivers: Turns given offerings into set items; sigil stone unlocks Daedric recipes.
kinds.evidence: One, in the Midden under the College of Winterhold (an activator with its own script, not a crafting keyword).

kinds.name: Skill trainer
kinds.delivers: Raises a skill for gold up to the trainer's cap: Journeyman 50, Expert 75, Master 90 (the CLAS cap); five trainings per player level. Detail names the skill and tier.
kinds.evidence: 54 JobTrainer<Skill>Faction members: Master 21, Expert 22, Journeyman 11; every one of the 18 skills has a Master and an Expert.

kinds.name: Skill book
kinds.delivers: A book placed in the world that raises its skill by one the first time it is read.
kinds.evidence: Skill books for all 18 skills (BOOK with a skill target).

kinds.name: Spell tome found
kinds.delivers: A tome placed as loot that teaches one spell (name it and its tier).
kinds.evidence: 111 spell tomes (BOOK teaching a SPEL), Novice to Master.

kinds.name: Rented room
kinds.delivers: An innkeeper rents a bed for a day (10 gold): sleep restores and gives the Rested bonus.
kinds.evidence: 20 LocTypeInn locations; beds placed: 1082 beds, 796 bedrolls.

kinds.name: Free bed
kinds.delivers: A bed or bedroll the player may sleep in without trespass (camps, barracks, owned houses).
kinds.evidence: 796 bedrolls placed, most in camps and dungeons the player has cleared.

kinds.name: Player home
kinds.delivers: A house the player can buy or build: safe storage, bed and crafting stations.
kinds.evidence: 8 LocTypePlayerHouse locations (the hold-city houses and the HearthFires plots).

kinds.name: Follower
kinds.delivers: A person who joins the player when asked or after a favour.
kinds.evidence: 67 NPCs in PotentialFollowerFaction.

kinds.name: Shrine blessing
kinds.delivers: Activating a shrine gives its god's blessing (a timed ability, 8 hours) and cures disease.
kinds.evidence: TempleBlessingScript shrines placed: Talos 20, Arkay 15, Dibella 11, Kynareth 10, Mara 10, Akatosh 9, Zenithar 9, Julianos 8, Stendarr 8, Auriel 4, Nocturnal 1.

kinds.name: Standing stone
kinds.delivers: A stone that sets the player's one permanent sign power; activating another replaces it.
kinds.evidence: 13 Doomstones (powerShrineScript) and 5 Skaal standing stones; 11 Doomstone and 5 BeastStone map markers.

kinds.name: Word of power
kinds.delivers: A wall that teaches one word of a shout (the player still needs a soul to unlock it).
kinds.evidence: 60 word walls placed (WordWallTrigger 47, DLC1 4, DLC2 9); 117 shouts and 107 words.

kinds.name: Power or ability altar
kinds.delivers: A shrine or altar that gives a power or ability other than a god's blessing (the vampire shrines, the Black Book stones).
kinds.evidence: DLC1VampireShrineScript (Night Power, Blood Magic); DLC2 altar shrines.

kinds.name: Ore or mineral vein
kinds.delivers: A vein the player mines with a pickaxe for ore, gems or clay (name the ore and how many).
kinds.evidence: MineOreScript veins placed: iron 694, corundum 249, silver 119, gold 97, orichalcum 93, quicksilver 73, moonstone 58, ebony 47, malachite 35, stalhrim 22, heart stone 28, clay 85, stone 57, gem geodes 52.

kinds.name: Rare harvestable
kinds.delivers: A plant, fungus or creature part that grows in few places and sells or brews well (name it).
kinds.evidence: Least-placed ingredient flora (of 70): pearls 157, bird eggs 365, giant lichen 143, swamp fungal pod 143, glow plants 66, nightshade 333, deathbell 237; against mountain flower 2314 and hanging moss 1895.

kinds.name: Common harvestables
kinds.delivers: Plenty of one or two ingredients or foods (name them).
kinds.evidence: Most-placed ingredient flora: mountain flowers 6000+, hanging moss 1895, snowberry 1837, chaurus eggs 1633.

kinds.name: Fish and clams
kinds.delivers: Fish caught by hand from schools in the water, clams on the shore (name the catch).
kinds.evidence: FoodClamMeat 1106, FoodSalmon 697, slaughterfish eggs 613 placed as harvest.

kinds.name: Boss chest
kinds.delivers: The locked chest at a hostile place's end, beside its strongest foe: gold, gems, a magic item chance, potions, scrolls and soul gems, at the place's tier (see the reward table).
kinds.evidence: 255 boss chests placed (bandit 80, draugr 67, dwarven 24, warlock 22, falmer 18, vampire 14, hagraven 13); one per cleared dungeon; contents are the levelled LootXChestBoss lists.

kinds.name: Lesser treasure
kinds.delivers: Ordinary chests, satchels, coin purses and urns along the way: small gold and common items at the place's tier.
kinds.evidence: 3645 non-boss Treas* containers placed; 806 coin purses as harvest.

kinds.name: Unique item
kinds.delivers: One named, fixed item placed by hand (a unique weapon, armour piece, staff or jewel), never levelled; reserved for the highest bands.
kinds.evidence: Bethesda's fixed rewards: the dragon priest masks (8 LocTypeDragonPriestLair) and the uniques on altars and bodies.

kinds.name: Gold hoard
kinds.delivers: Loose gold and gems laid out (a dragon's hoard, a pirate stash).
kinds.evidence: Gold piles beside boss chests in dragon lairs (11 LocTypeDragonLair).

kinds.name: Hostile occupants
kinds.delivers: The place's foes at its fixed danger band (name who). Must name its reward.
kinds.evidence: Every LocTypeClearable location (244) pairs its foes with a boss chest; 349 of 355 encounter zones set a minimum level, 90 never reset.

kinds.name: Boss fight
kinds.delivers: One strong named or leader foe at the place's end (name it). Must name its reward, a boss-chest, unique-item or gold-hoard.
kinds.evidence: Bethesda puts the boss chest in the boss's room: 255 boss chests for 244 clearable locations.

kinds.name: Dangerous wildlife
kinds.delivers: Predators or monsters roaming the site (name them). Must name its reward (their pelts and parts count only as harvest-common).
kinds.evidence: Animal dens (20 LocTypeAnimalDen) carry 5 boss chests; the rest reward with hides and parts.
